title: Sand + Sky | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Featured in Coastal Lifestyle Magazine - New Home Adjacent to Luxury Resort Pool - Gated - Gulf Views - Short Stroll Beach Access - 3 Stories of Opulence - All En Suite Accommodations - Incredible Finishes Throughout
description_expanded: Description: Sand & Sky by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach - Gated SeaNest Village on 30A Address: 238 Sand Oaks Circle, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: Discover Sand + Sky, a newly built luxury retreat in the gated SeaNest community of Seagrove Beach along 30A. Designed for an elevated coastal experience, this 4,000-square-foot home offers the perfect blend of modern elegance, comfort, and convenience just moments from the Gulf’s white-sand beaches and emerald waters. Spanning three levels, the home features five bedrooms and five-and-a-half bathrooms, thoughtfully arranged to provide both spacious gathering areas and private retreats. The main living level is the heart of the home, showcasing an open-concept design with a chef’s kitchen, high-end appliances, a stunning wine display, and a large island ideal for entertaining. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly to a covered porch with a summer kitchen, creating effortless indoor-outdoor living. Upstairs, a secondary living space with a wet bar opens to a sun terrace with beautiful Gulf views—perfect for relaxing after a day at the beach. The primary suite offers a true retreat with a spa-inspired bathroom and generous walk-in closet, while additional guest suites provide comfort and privacy for every member of your group. With custom finishes throughout, multiple porches, and close proximity to Seagrove’s shops, dining, and beach access, Sand + Sky is designed to deliver a refined and memorable 30A getaway. Home Highlights- - Just a 5-Minute Walk to Community Beach Access - Infinity Resort-Style Pool Adjacent to Home - Gulf Views from 3rd Floor Sun Terrace - Multiple Outdoor Living Spaces - Summer Kitchen for Easy Entertaining - 4,000 Square Feet of Living Space - Gated Community Setting - 6 Adult Bikes Included - Beach Towel Service - Walk to Greenway Shops, Dining, and Old Florida Favorites - Easy Bike or Walk to Seagrove Highlights Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps 14 5 Bedrooms | 5 Full Baths | 1 Half Bath | 1 Outdoor Shower First Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath - Bedroom 2: Two Twin over Full Bunk Beds with Private Bath - Living/Family Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Vessel Tub and Sower) -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area / Open Concept Floor Plan / Outdoor Grilling and Balcony / View of Resort Pool Third Floor: -Bedroom 4: King Bed, Private Bath (Vessel Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 5: King Bed Private Bath (Shower) - Living Space, Balcony, Firepit, Gulf Views, View of Resort Pool Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
